The JSON fixtures are Intuit's public API reference sample responses, retrieved
September 24, 2026. They contain Intuit's sample company data, not Campfire data.

- https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/report-entities/profitandloss
- https://developer.intuit.com/app/developer/qbo/docs/api/accounting/report-entities/balancesheet

These validate the provider's published schema independently of our own generated
fixtures. They do not replace verification against the owner's actual company.
